messages:
sam: FYI PR #4721 preview is failing the docs CI after the migration guide rename; two quick things flagged: an anchor that now 404s and a new Vale prose rule complaining about passive phrasing. Can someone pick this up? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 :eyes:

mia: I can grab the anchor cleanup. Which file has the broken anchor?

sam: migration/migrate-v1-to-v2.md — we renamed the header from `Configuring the runtime` to `Runtime configuration` in the PR, but we didn't update the internal anchor or the cross-ref from ops/latency.md. The preview shows a 404 on the link.

ci-bot: build_preview #4721 failed: linkcheck -> 1 broken link (migration/migrate-v1-to-v2.md#configuring-the-runtime); vale -> 2 prose warnings. Logs: `Link check error: anchor not found`

mia: I'll update the anchor references and add a redirect anchor at the top of the migration doc to be safe. Quick patch: add `<!-- anchor: configuring-the-runtime -->` under the old heading and update the cross-ref.

jen: Also saw the Vale warnings: ops/latency.md has sentences flagged as passive (rule: 'ProsePassiveVoice'). Suggested replacement: change "it is recommended to" -> "we recommend" or rewrite active voice. Can we fix both in one small patch?

kevin: There's also a minor SDK snippet in the same PR where a code fence language tag is missing which makes the syntax highlight weird in preview. I can add the correct triple backticks with `json`/`bash` as needed.

sam: Plan: mia fixes anchor + add comment anchor, jen rewrites the two passive sentences, kevin fixes code fence and runs local checks. After push, run `yarn docs:preview --pr 4721` and let CI run. Who will review?

jen: I can review the content changes once pushed. If CI looks green we can merge this morning — small changes only. :thumbsup:

mia: Pushed anchor patch in branch `fix/docs-anchor-4721` and updated cross-ref. Ran `npx vale ops/latency.md migration/migrate-v1-to-v2.md` locally, got remaining prose warnings for jen to check.

kevin: Pushed fence + snippet fix in `fix/docs-snippet-4721`. Also ran `yarn lint:md` locally, no remaining markdown-lint errors.

ci-bot: preview for branches `fix/docs-anchor-4721` and `fix/docs-snippet-4721` triggered. linkcheck now passes for the migration doc; vale shows 1 remaining warning in ops/latency.md.

jen: Rewrote the flagged sentences and pushed to `fix/docs-prose-4721`. Please re-run vale locally with `npx vale --config=.vale.ini ops/latency.md` before pushing.

sam: Awesome. After all three branches are merged into the PR, I'll rebase and kick off the final preview. If green, I'll merge and backport the small anchor redirect to stable. Thanks all! :rocket:
